backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining trade, account, user profile types, in‑memory storage, performance metrics, and CRUD operations secured with admin/user authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence record describing a UI change requiring the Home page Total P&L span to show static text "17.5" with no formatting.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of many frontend files used as reference for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme configuration defining CSS variables for light/dark modes and global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with public and admin routes, wraps the app in a theme provider and site‑wide gate.
Admin layout with header, logout button, and content container, using Internet Identity and admin auth state.
frontend/src/components/app/AppHeader.ts: Header showing the wordmark logo linking to the homepage.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicFooter: Footer with trading disclaimer and minimal copyright text.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicLayout: Public site layout with header, navigation bar, textured background, main content, and footer.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/A: Modal form for creating or editing a managed account, handling form state, validation, and API mutations.
Admin table listing all accounts with actions to add, edit, and delete using dialogs and mutations.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/C: Panel for uploading a CSV of trades, validating rows, previewing results, and batch-importing via API.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/M: Card UI for viewing and updating performance metrics through a simple form and mutation call.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/T: Dialog form for adding or editing a trade, managing form state and submitting data via mutations.
Displays a table of trades with loading states and supports adding, editing, and deleting trades.
frontend/src/features/admin/hooks/useAdm: Provides React Query mutation hooks for adding, updating, and deleting trades, accounts, and performance metrics.
frontend/src/features/admin/pages/AdminD: Renders the admin dashboard with tabbed sections for trades, accounts, metrics, and CSV import.
frontend/src/features/admin/utils/csv.ts: Parses and validates CSV trade data, returning valid entries and detailed row-level errors.
frontend/src/features/analytics/componen: Draws an SVG equity curve with grid lines, area shading, and axes based on sequential equity data.
Renders a scrollable SVG bar chart showing monthly profit and loss values.
Displays a donut chart and legend summarizing win/loss trade counts and percentages.
frontend/src/features/analytics/pages/Pe: Fetches performance data and displays monthly P&L, win/loss distribution, and equity curve charts with loading states.
frontend/src/features/analytics/utils/an: Provides helpers to compute monthly PnL, win/loss counts, and an equity curve from trade data.
frontend/src/features/auth/components/Ad: Gate component that checks admin authentication and redirects or blocks access based on auth state.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/useAdmi: Hook that determines if the user is authenticated and an admin by querying the backend actor.
frontend/src/features/auth/pages/AdminLo: Admin login screen that triggers Internet Identity login and redirects authenticated admins.
frontend/src/features/auth/types.ts: Defines basic auth-related types for authentication status and state.
frontend/src/features/data/queries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching performance metrics, trades, and managed accounts from the backend actor.
frontend/src/features/public/components/: Renders a simple SVG-based account growth chart generated from a balance value.
UI component for filtering trades by month, year, and profit/loss result.
Displays a styled table of trades with dates, prices, direction, quantities, and P&L.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/HomeP: Public home page showing overall trading performance metrics with cards and visual indicators.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Manag: Displays managed accounts with balance, risk profile, and growth charts, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Portf: Shows trade history with filters and a table, applying client-side filtering and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/features/public/utils/maski: Masks account names by obscuring middle characters while preserving the first and last two.
frontend/src/features/seo/usePageMeta.ts: Sets document title and meta description using a React hook.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/GateScree: Renders a credential form with loading and error states for gated site access.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/SiteWideG: Wraps content with a site-wide access gate that verifies credentials and redirects on success.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/useSiteGa: Manages site gate state using sessionStorage and validates credentials for unlocking access.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on identity, refreshing related queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login handling, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes with chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, query client, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL params (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and remove them from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS config defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature state, and configuration for the current build process.
